card.name: Verb stem just before -ing or -ance
card.fires_on: A verb stem that is complete but not yet finished, where the next piece is an ending such as -ing, -ers or -ance. Seen on words like exceed, taper, interrupt, endanger and reposition.

modes.label: Stem before -ing
modes.description: A bare verb stem whose next piece is -ing, in medical or news text.
modes.example: In others, gradually<< taper>>ing a patient off of a prescribed benz

modes.description: A stem followed by -ers or -ance rather than -ing.

modes.description: A verb stem sitting after a prefix such as ex or re, awaiting its ending.

card.writes: It pushes against an -ing ending and favors other word endings, so the model finishes the word differently.
card.plain: It marks a verb stem where the model should not simply add -ing.
